data.body: Ticket 3 (beaming-snively-urial) plan-review PASSED after major research-driven rescope: discovered aggregate.py::aggregate_findings is genuinely dead code (no caller in src/ since ADR 0075 retired the single-pass code-review route; the epic's original problem statement's claim about it was stale/wrong for current code). Live dedup (_cluster_findings in workflow_ops.py, dedup_key/suppress_and_dedup in review_kernel/decide.py) picks representatives first-in-order, not by severity/priority -- no live misranking bug there. Also discovered adapter.py's Gerrit path already reads priority directly off the kernel verdict, bypassing shim.py entirely -- so shim.py's _to_common_finding serves a DIFFERENT live consumer: review_result (rebar review-code / review_code MCP tool). Rescoped ticket 3 to ONLY thread priority+decision through shim.py for that consumer; aggregate.py and spec_scan.py explicitly out of scope (verified via zero-diff AC). Also proactively fixed ticket 4 (patriotic-abdicative-arrowana): its plan to delete shim.py's _KERNEL_TO_COMMON_SEVERITY was premature (would break review_result's schema-required severity field before ticket 6's contract phase) -- only adapter.py's own copy is deleted by ticket 4; shim.py's stays. Claiming ticket 3 now.
